subject: CoEngine integration — commercial split, lead escrow & pilot plan
messages:
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@coengine.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@coengine.io
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Interest in a reseller + referral model for CoEngine connector

Hi Sean — great meeting last week. CoEngine's customers are asking for a first-class Redwood connector. We'd like to discuss a simple commercial framework: a referral fee for leads we hand off plus a resale/rev-share option if we bundle Redwood into our managed offering.

High-level asks from our side: 1) ability to register inbound leads so CoEngine gets first-touch credit, 2) a rev-share on net ARR when we actively sell Redwood as part of a paid integration, and 3) an introductory pilot credit for three customers.

Can you share the typical % bands you use and any required lead-escrow/process? Happy to run this through procurement once we have a term sheet.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Head of Partnerships, CoEngine
[Attachment: CoEngine_integration_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@coengine.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in a reseller + referral model for CoEngine connector

Alex — thanks, excited by the opportunity. High level we usually structure two tracks: referral (flat % on first-year net ARR for registered leads) and reseller/rev-share (share of net ARR for customers transacted through partner-managed contracts). Typical ranges: referral 8–12% first-year; rev-share 15–30% depending on seat commitment and who owns billing.

About lead handling: we support a registration window (usually 60–120 days) and a proof-of-intro requirement (email thread, demo note, or CRM record). For higher-value accounts we can put leads in a short-term escrow flag in our partner portal while legal finalizes agreement.

Looping Marissa (partner ops) and Karthik (commercial) to draft a short term sheet and confirm ops requirements. Can CoEngine share estimated annual contract sizes for target customers and whether you want lead registration to be exclusive?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0126
[Attachment referenced: none]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@coengine.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in a reseller + referral model for CoEngine connector

Alex — thanks for the note. I attached a starter term-sheet and draft SOW that mirrors how we've run similar ISV relationships. Operational notes up front: 

- Lead registration: CoEngine submits via HubSpot partner form + email thread; registration holds for 90 days by default.
- Proof-of-intro: demo invite + follow-up email or CRM activity is acceptable.
- Escrow: we can mark the Opp as "pending partner review" in Partner Portal; final allocation happens at PO or signed contract.
- Rev-share calculation: net ARR after discounts and credits; billed monthly to Redwood, revenue share paid quarterly with standard clawback window of 12 months in case of churn/credits.

Proposed commercial anchors in attached sheet: referral 10% for first-year net ARR; reseller rev-share 22% on net ARR for the first 12 months, stepping down for year 2. These are starting points — Karthik, can you confirm cadence for partner payouts and whether a minimum threshold applies?

Next steps: Alex, if you can review the attached term-sheet and SOW (CoEngine_revshare_term_sheet_v1.xlsx, CoEngine_SOW_draft.pdf) and flag changes, we can route to legal and procurement. If procurement prefers a consolidated MSAs + SOW + DocuSign path, share the procurement contact and we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CoEngine_revshare_term_sheet_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@coengine.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@coengine.io
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in a reseller + referral model for CoEngine connector

Thanks Marissa — we reviewed the sheet with our CFO and legal. A few counterpoints: 

1) Rev-share ask: CoEngine requests 27.5% on net ARR for the first 12 months (we're investing marketing and managed services).
2) Lead registration exclusivity: we'd like exclusivity for registered inbound leads while the opportunity is in negotiation (up to 180 days) for named accounts > $150k ACV.
3) Pilot credits: request 3 months of hosted credits plus a waived integration fee for first three pilot customers.

We uploaded a marked term sheet (attached) and added comments in the SOW for the support SLAs. Procurement is fine to sign in DocuSign once we align commercial points. Link to marked file in our drive: https://drive.coengine.io/rdw/CE-003/marked-term-sheet

Can Karthik and Marissa advise which of these items require Exec approval vs standard partner ops exception?

—Alex

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@coengine.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.g@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interest in a reseller + referral model for CoEngine connector

Alex — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers: 

- Rev-share at 27.5% is above standard band but not immovable; would require VP/GM approval for a strategic partnership. Please provide ARR forecast for the first 12 months and estimated marketing investment; that'll help business case.
- Exclusivity for high-value named accounts (>$150k ACV) for 180 days is a negotiable sales protection clause; ops can support a 120-day registration hold with an escalated approval path for 180 days when you show pipeline evidence.
- Pilot credits and waived integration fee: partner promo credits are fine for a pilot cohort (we typically cap total credit value); waived integration fee needs alignment with Solutions Engineering budget but OK for up to three pilots pending SE capacity.

If you can drop the forecast and the marked term-sheet into the HubSpot deal record (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/rdw/deal/CE-003) we'll prepare a short approval memo and route to VP of Partner Sales. I can draft the memo once we have numbers — target turnaround ~3 business days.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
